segments.sn11.7:1.2: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, sakkassa devānamindassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi –
segments.sn11.7:1.3: ‘yopi me assa supaccatthiko tassapāhaṃ na dubbheyyan’ti.
segments.sn11.7:1.4: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asurindo sakkassa devānamindassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yena sakko devānamindo tenupasaṅkami.
segments.sn11.7:1.5: Addasā kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo vepacittiṃ asurindaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.sn11.7:2.1: “Yadeva te, mārisa, pubbe cittaṃ, tadeva tvaṃ mā pajahāsī”ti [tadeva tvaṃ mārisa pahāsīti (sī. syā. kaṃ.)].
segments.sn11.7:4.1: “Yaṃ musā bhaṇato pāpaṃ, yaṃ pāpaṃ ariyūpavādino;
segments.sn11.7:4.3: Mittadduno ca yaṃ pāpaṃ, yaṃ pāpaṃ akataññuno;
segments.sn11.7:4.5: Tameva pāpaṃ phusatu [phusati (sī. pī.)], yo te dubbhe sujampatī”ti.

lines: Sattame upasaṅkamīti “ayaṃ sakko ‘yopi me assa supaccatthiko, tassa pāhaṃ na dubbheyyan’ti cinteti, mayā tassa paccatthikataro nāma natthi, vīmaṃsissāmi tāva naṃ, kiṃ nu kho maṃ passitvā dubbhati, na dubbhatī”ti cintetvā upasaṅkami.
Tiṭṭha vepacitti gahitosīti vepacitti, ettheva tiṭṭha, gahito tvaṃ mayāti vadati.
Saha vacanenevassa so kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi baddhova ahosi.
Sapassu ca meti mayi adubbhatthāya sapathaṃ karohīti vadati.
Yaṃ musābhaṇato pāpanti imasmiṃ kappe paṭhamakappikesu cetiyarañño pāpaṃ sandhāyāha.
Mittadduno ca yaṃ pāpanti mahākapijātake mahāsatte duṭṭhacittassa pāpaṃ.
Imāni kira imasmiṃ kappe cattāri mahāpāpāni.
Cetiyarājā kira imasmiṃ kappe tato pubbe kenaci avuttapubbaṃ kharamusāvādaṃ abhāsi, tāvadeva virajjhitvā mahāpathaviyā vivare dine nipatitvā avīciaggijālānamindanamahosi.
Tathā hi vepacittino sapathakaraṇe nidassanabhāvena etāni aṭṭhakathāyaṃ āgatānīti.
